# Capability flags

<!-- Generated by go test ./internal/sched -run '^TestCapabilityFlagsDoc$' -update. Do not edit. -->

Capability flags open: 8.

Every public parse method builds one `internal/sched.Request` and calls `sched.Parse`.
The request names the modes that the call needs.
This table says whether the compact engine serves each mode.
A mode that compact does not serve is an open flag: only the legacy engine serves a request that needs it.
The table does not decide policy. The admission switch, the allowlist, per-parser overrides, sub-parser pins, and nested-parse suppression stay in the root package.

| Flag | Compact serves it | Closes with | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `incremental` | yes | compact incremental reuse | A reparse with an edited old tree. Compact reuses subtrees when the old tree and the scanner allow it; see scanner_state_reuse and old_tree_reuse. |
| `utf16` | yes | UTF-8 view | UTF-16 input. Every engine parses the UTF-8 view, and the tree maps ranges back to UTF-16. |
| `profiling` | yes | compact incremental timing | Incremental attribution in IncrementalParseProfile. The compact incremental route records the same timing fields. |
| `strict` | yes | result check | A partial tree becomes ErrParseStoppedEarly. The check reads the returned tree, so it does not depend on the engine. |
| `deadline` | yes | tranche B8 | A timeout or a cancellation flag. The compact scheduler polls both and falls back with a compatible stop reason. |
| `token_source` | no (open) | E-D1 | A caller-supplied TokenSource or TokenSourceFactory. Compact reproduces only the built-in DFA token stream. |
| `included_ranges` | no (open) | E-D2 | Included ranges. Compact lexes the whole source and does not apply ranges. |
| `observer` | no (open) | E-D3 | A logger, a GLR trace, an ambiguity profile, or GOT_PARSE_PROGRESS events. Compact emits none of these events. |
| `work_limits` | no (open) | E-D4 | Explicit ParseWorkLimits. Compact keeps separate work counters and must not spend work before a legacy limit trips. |
| `forest_route` | no (open) | E-D6 | A language that defaults to the GSS-forest route, unless its parser forces the compact route, and ParseForestExperimental. The forest engine serves these requests. |
| `measurement` | no (open) | D-A3 | The benchmark-only modes: no tree, no tree with external checkpoints, and no result compatibility. They measure legacy internals. |
| `scanner_state_reuse` | no (open) | E-E1 | Incremental reuse with an external scanner that is not stateless. Compact reuse needs a stateless scanner. |
| `old_tree_reuse` | no (open) | E-E7 | Incremental reuse of an old tree that compact did not build, whose root has an error, that lacks a replay proof, that has no recorded edit, or that belongs to another language. |
